findings.details: Implemented canonical FNS Order EA-7-11/824@ logic: 10-digit legal entity and 12-digit individual INN check-digit calculation with GOST/FNS weights; calendar tax year isolation; exact integer kopecks aggregation; Code 1 (standard capped at 150 000 ₽ for 2024+ / 120 000 ₽ pre-2024) vs Code 2 (expensive dental treatment per Decree No. 458, uncapped); net refund subtractions; full kinship support (patient, spouse, parent, child); official printable HTML with Code 128 barcode and verification QR.

Implemented strict Order of Minzdrav RF No. 1094n compliance: Latin MNN generation, strict dosage and quantity validation, rejection of vague/indefinite Signa ('по схеме', 'по назначению врача', 'как обычно'), official A5 portrait printable HTML with clinic stamp, doctor seal area ('М.П. ВРАЧ'), and prescription stamp ('ДЛЯ РЕЦЕПТОВ').

Created TaxCertificateModal.tsx featuring tax year selection, relative taxpayer credentials, real-time INN validation status badge, fiscal payment list with Code 1 / Code 2 badge breakdown, summary cards, and 1-click print.

Zero synthetic mocks (zero Ivanovs, Petrs, Sidorovs), zero cartoon emojis (Mandate 8d pt 7), all files strictly under 800-line anti-monolith limit (607, 547, 466, 441 lines). Zero touches to CT / CBCT / radiology scope.
26/26 unit tests passing (100% pass, 0 failures, duration ~2.2s).
